description: Refactor PRD — leave internal/telegram/ as a thin Telegram-channel wrapper. Target architecture (from the user's diagram): Channels (Telegram + Cron) → Chat Hub (Inbound) → Agent Loop (build context, call LLM, execute tools — backed by Memory/Sessions/Skills, LLM provider, filesystem/exec/web) → Chat Hub (Outbound) → Channels (Telegram). Telegram becomes one of N channel adapters; cron-driven agent jobs become a real chat.InboundAdapter publishing through chat.Hub. End state: internal/telegram/ contains ONLY Telegram-channel concerns (telebot wiring, entity rendering, document upload, /commands, allowlist gating). All composition wiring lives in cmd/aura/app.go. All agent orchestration lives in internal/agent/ + internal/channels/telegram/. All scheduled-dispatch logic lives in internal/cron/ + internal/channels/cron/. One story = one atomic commit on master (memory feedback_one_module_per_slice 2026-05-14). Heartbeat is a future channel (constant declared in chat.ChannelHeartbeat but no producer today) — out of scope for this queue.
